legalData: Fityesz Krónika can be played without an account: your progress then stays in your own browser. If you create an account, we store your account and your progress on a server so you can pick the story up elsewhere. This section sets out exactly what that means.
legalAccountT: What we store if you create an account
legalAccount: Creating an account stores your e-mail address, the username you choose, and an encrypted form of your password — we never see the password itself. Playing while signed in also stores the name the game calls you, how far you got, your XP and exposure score, the items you hold and the choices you made. Nothing else: we run no analytics, build no profiles, show no ads and sell nothing to anyone.
legalBasis: We store it to provide the account you asked for and to keep your progress (GDPR Article 6(1)(b) — performance of a contract). Playing without an account needs none of it: the browser chapter can be played through without signing up.
legalProcessor: Accounts and saves are stored with Supabase Inc., acting as our data processor. Beyond them and the hosting provider, no one else receives your data. Supabase Inc. is a US company; where it stores the data is given below. Any access from outside the EEA is covered by the standard contractual clauses in our data processing agreement with them.
legalRetention: Your account and its save stay until you ask us to delete them. The Restart button in the game overwrites the saved run immediately. To have the whole account and everything in it erased, write to the address above; we will action it within 30 days at the latest.
legalTerms: An account is free and we use it for nothing beyond keeping your progress in the game. The service is provided as it is, with no guarantee of availability, and you can delete your account at any time. We reserve the right to close an account that is misused — for instance in an attempt to break into someone else's.
legalLocalT: Save data stored in your browser
legalLocal: Playing without signing in keeps everything in your own browser's localStorage: the name you give, your choices and your score. That never reaches us. Clearing your browser data removes it, as does the Restart button in the game. If you sign in later, the run in your browser is moved into your account — from that point it is stored on the server as described above.
legalFonts: Fonts are served from our own host, so viewing the site makes no request to Google or any other third party; we set no tracking cookies and run no analytics. When you sign in, or play while signed in, your browser talks to Supabase to read and write your save and keeps the session token in its own storage — without that the account could not work. GitHub and Ko-fi links only open if you click them.
legalRights: You can ask for a copy of the data we hold about you, have it corrected, have it erased, have its use restricted, receive it in a portable form, or object to it being processed. Write to the address above. If you believe we have handled your data wrongly you can complain to the Hungarian data protection authority (NAIH, naih.hu).
legalIp: The text of Fityesz Krónika and this website were made by the creators. The site's typefaces — Antonio and Public Sans — are available under the SIL Open Font License 1.1 and are served from our own host.
legalSatire: Fityesz Krónika is a work of satire. It depicts no real person or organisation and uses no existing party's logo, wordmark or branding.
